title: Item Auto-Balance (staff)
body:
Syntax: itemscale | itemscale preview <level> | itemscale <damage|armor|value|uses> <25-400|+/-delta> | itemscale reset <field|all>

New immortal/builder-created weapons, armor and job tools automatically gain the AutoBalance flag when you set ITEMTYPE (or WEAPONTYPE for weapons). OCOPY also enables it on new copies of this gear. Existing saved items, armor and other objects are NOT mass-changed.

Builder: OCREATE <vnum> <name> then OSET <vnum> ITEMTYPE weapon|armor|tool, OSET <vnum> LEVEL <1-250>. AutoBalance is already ON; no manual flag needed. OSET <vnum> WEAPONTYPE sword also marks it as a weapon and enables AutoBalance. OSTAT <vnum> previews the effective stats. Existing objects can still use OSET <vnum> FLAGS AutoBalance; an intentionally custom prototype can use FLAGS -AutoBalance.

Administrator: ITEMSCALE to see current percentages, ITEMSCALE PREVIEW <level>, ITEMSCALE DAMAGE <25-400>, ITEMSCALE ARMOR <25-400>, ITEMSCALE VALUE <25-400>, ITEMSCALE USES <25-400>, ITEMSCALE ARMOR +10 or ITEMSCALE DAMAGE -10 to shift a current percentage, ITEMSCALE RESET DAMAGE or ITEMSCALE RESET ALL.

The scaling flag takes effect at item levels 1-250. Weapon base damage, armor AC protection, shop value, and tool maximum uses are calculated from item level and saved global settings. Explicit item DAMAGE, armor STATBONUS ARMOR_CLASS, COST and custom USES override their corresponding automatic values. The item name, VNUM, forged stats, gems and manual builder settings are never overwritten. Settings save to data/item_balance.json; runtime values update immediately (previously used tool durability is preserved).
